compress.variation: the base methodology, BUT replace the implemented order-2/order-1 arithmetic mixture with a sparse order-4 PPM predictor: try the longest learned byte context first, emit an adaptive escape for an unseen continuation, and back off through shorter contexts while excluding symbols already represented by higher contexts. The parent actually uses a dense order-1 table plus sparse order-2 counts with fixed backoff and rescaling; this variation keeps explicit high-order continuation counts and lets escape mass avoid impossible lower-order alternatives. A global order-0 model guarantees every byte remains representable, and all tables are learned only from prior input bytes.
